question: Which of the following organisations was awarded with the Nobel Peace Prize 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __World Food Programme.__

__
 
• ​The 2020 Nobel Peace Prize has been awarded to the World Food Programme (WFP), a United Nations (UN) agency.
